The design brief

Calm. Considered. Human.

Make Pilates feel welcoming to beginners while giving returning visitors a simple way to compare classes.

The intended experience

Help a first-time visitor find a class that feels right and feel comfortable asking to join.

A closer look

Designed around
the business.

Soft lilac, sculptural typography, and spacious layouts reflect a slower, more intentional pace. Class information explains the experience without relying on fitness jargon.
